meta.disclaimer: Analytics, not financial advice. The median tradeable token on this chain returns 0.90x per day — read every number against that.

confluence.label: Confluence
confluence.trigger: 3+ distinct whales bought the same token within 60 minutes

newborn.label: Newborn
newborn.trigger: 2+ whales bought a token less than 2h old (age measured from the pool's on-chain creation)

accum.label: Accumulation
accum.trigger: sustained net buying over 12h with almost no selling

accum_slow.label: Slow accumulation
accum_slow.trigger: the same shape over 72h — a position built patiently rather than in one burst

surge.label: Surge
surge.trigger: a burst of net inflow over 3h on an already-established token

early.label: Early
early.trigger: a candidate the main tier dropped only for being small, thin or churny — caught earlier, at a lower cap, and rug-checked before it is sent
early.note: with only 3 buyers the money floor rises to $2,000; every Early ping also carries a live rug/honeypot check scoring at least 60
